question: 过去半个月卖了多少件商品？
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND o.order_date >= '2026-10-18'

question: 成都和重庆哪个卖得更好？
gold_sql: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.city IN ('成都','重庆') GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 1

question: 销售额排名前三的渠道
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 3

question: 会员等级为金卡的客户贡献了多少订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.level='金卡'

question: 2026年8月到10月的销售额分别是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) IN ('2026-08','2026-09','2026-10') GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym

question: 西安有多少个下单客户？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND c.city='西安'

question: 各品类的销量占比是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.qty)*100.0/(SELECT SUM(oi2.qty) FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id=o2.id WHERE o2.status IN ('已支付','已完成')),2) AS pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY pct DESC

question: 上个季度销售额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.amount),2) AS gmv FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) IN ('2026-07','2026-08','2026-09')
